Every 'expect' value must be verified against an EXTERNAL source (NASA/Espenak local circumstances, Jubier maps) and recorded in 'verified_against'. A fixture whose expected value was generated by the same model being tested is not a fixture — it is a mirror.

Only a full-catalog search finds prev=1715 and next=2090, and the ~375yr drought they were born inside. If this fixture passes, the engine is searching correctly.

If NO totality in 5 millennia crossed this point, totality_over_birthplace.ever must be false and both prev/next null. State it plainly. Do NOT substitute a nearby path — that is what closest_approach is for.
